query_text: 想找一家服务特别到位的餐厅，员工友好又上心的那种，大家有好推荐吗？
requirement_text: 评论中应明确描述店内员工是否友善、周到并及时照顾顾客。
evidence_span: service was perfect. Staff was friendly, knowledgable, and attentive without being overbearing.
evidence_context: Last but not least, service was perfect. Staff was friendly, knowledgable, and attentive without being overbearing. Our waitress gave great recommendations and asked for feedback. All in all, it was a great experience!

query_text: 哪家餐馆的服务员热情主动、会随时关照客人的需求？
requirement_text: 评论需直接说明该店员工的态度以及对顾客需求的关注情况。
evidence_span: the staff was amazingly friendly. The staff was very attentive to our needs and checked up on us to make sure everything was good.
evidence_context: Today was my first time here and it was amazing. The food was absolutely delicious and the staff was amazingly friendly. The staff was very attentive to our needs and checked up on us to make sure everything was good. I appreciated that they didn't hover like a lot of waitresses do at other restaurants. Food was already preparied and ready to go which didn't take long to surve us. Me and my family will definitely be going back.

query_text: 有没有哪家餐厅服务差到叫服务员都无人理会的？想提前避雷。
requirement_text: 评论需说明店内员工是否怠慢顾客、不予回应或让顾客久等。
evidence_span: The waiter would not even answer you when there were only 3 customers in the restaurant. waited 20 minutes for the check.
evidence_context: Poor service. The waiter would not even answer you when there were only 3 customers in the restaurant. waited 20 minutes for the check.

query_text: 求问有没有店里人手不少却完全无视顾客的糟糕餐厅？
requirement_text: 评论需直接描述顾客到店后是否被员工冷落或无视。
evidence_span: There was TONS of staff, standing behind the counter there, walking in and out of the kitchen.  I was there a WHILE with menus in hand.  Nobody even looked at me let alone greeted me.
evidence_context: TERRIBLE service.  Came in and sat down at the bar, right in front of the kitchen doors.  There was TONS of staff, standing behind the counter there, walking in and out of the kitchen.  I was there a WHILE with menus in hand.  Nobody even looked at me let alone greeted me.  Left hungry and annoyed.  How hard would "hi" be?  Wont be returning.  Pretentious and tbh I dont love their beer anyway.
